Louis Roederer's 2002 Cristal is quickly becoming a legendary Champagne that you need to know about. Arguably the best ever, it is super powerful but it still needs quite a few years in bottle. Click here for James' note and score .
To get an idea of just how precious 2002 Cristal is, watch this video. You'll see the recent launch in Hong Kong of 200 jeroboams of the Champagne crafted with 24-carat golden nets. A remarkable bottling for a remarkable vintage. The price tag is US$25000 but the good news is that a normal bottle with cost you "only" around US$300.
The event also showcased the 2006 vintage. Click here for James' note and score .
